ITEM 1 | Fresh spinach leaves, dark green, flat and crinkled with visible light-green midribs and stems, spread in a loose pile covering roughly a quarter of the plate on the left side, slightly moist with no sheen or sauce | 45
ITEM 2 | Cherry tomatoes, bright red, smooth glossy skins, whole and intact, about 2.5-3 cm long, seven pieces clustered in the upper right of the plate, firm and round with no cut surfaces or cooking marks | 105
ITEM 3 | Cooked white rice, off-white grains, loose and separated, slightly clumped in small pieces, moist but not sticky, forming a small mound about 5 cm across on the right side of the plate next to the tomatoes | 50
ITEM 4 | Red seedless grapes, dark red to purplish skins, whole and firm, about 1.5-2 cm each, eight pieces clustered in the lower center of the plate, smooth and slightly glossy with no cut surfaces or cooking marks | 85
